title: Billing Department Statement: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Reset Alert Amount
content:
The reset alert amount of a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) enrollment is the warning days multiplied by the alert daily cost, rounded up to the next whole dollar, never lower than the alert amount the enrollment already carries, and kept within the tier's lowest and highest low-balance alert amounts. The warning days are the tier's disconnect warning days. The alert daily cost is the total of the enrollment's daily charge lines in the one-month window divided by the number of service days those lines cover in that window. A window of a stated number of months takes the records dated after the same day of the month that many months before the current date, through the current date.

The amount is built in this order: the product of the warning days and the alert daily cost, unrounded; that product rounded up to the next whole dollar (a product that is already a whole dollar stays as it is); the higher of that figure and the alert amount the enrollment already carries; and that figure held between the tier's lowest and highest alert amounts.

### Worked figures (hypothetical records; for illustration 3 warning days, a lowest alert amount of 10.00 and a highest of 100.00)

| | Case A | Case B | Case C |
|---|---|---|---|
| Daily charge lines in the one-month window | 148.20 | 279.00 | 1240.00 |
| Service days those lines cover | 30 | 31 | 31 |
| Alert daily cost | 4.94 | 9.00 | 40.00 |
| Warning days multiplied by alert daily cost | 14.82 | 27.00 | 120.00 |
| Rounded up to the whole dollar | 15.00 | 27.00 | 120.00 |
| Alert amount already carried | 20.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 |
| Higher of the two | 20.00 | 27.00 | 120.00 |
| Reset alert amount, within 10.00 to 100.00 | 20.00 | 27.00 | 100.00 |
